title: Freeze Weapon VFX
description: Freeze Weapon VFX. Milestone 2 credit burn, v1.0. Projectile is an 8×64 strip. Charge, static AOE, and hit are 1-frame images (AOE pose 96×96). `vfx-freeze-aoe-explode` is the 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Does not replace live hero weapon sheets (fx-sling-pellet, frost, flame, bubble, lightning). Water was not part of this export. SFX keys are notes only; no audio files.

assets.note: v1.0. 8-frame fly strip. Does not replace live frost sheets. PixelLab object 3b8d70ec-417e-4b2a-abbe-812c148d887b. SFX `sfx-weapon-freeze-shot` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame charge. Static 1-frame. Stage can tween or scale. PixelLab object 8285f90e-0b5a-4700-9947-5f7f93b1fa27. SFX `sfx-weapon-freeze-charge` (index note only; no audio file).

v1.0. Static 1-frame AOE impact pose, kept as the fallback. Animated ground burst is `vfx-freeze-aoe-explode` (8×96, origin (0.5, 0.75)). PixelLab object 9233fcad-252d-4191-9fd8-a9310ed3274d. SFX `sfx-weapon-freeze-aoe` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame hit. PixelLab object 95abeec6-5d95-4bc3-986b-071e72f3247a. SFX `sfx-weapon-freeze-hit` (index note only; no audio file).

v1.0. 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Alternate foot hint (0.5, 0.85). Ice-spike frost nova that expands and settles. Freeze frames 1–2 were soft-shifted +4px right inside the same 96 canvas. Raw frames are not cataloged. Same PixelLab object as `vfx-freeze-aoe` (9233fcad-252d-4191-9fd8-a9310ed3274d); burst group 81926ee6-2860-4f77-9e06-d29d6063e06e. Static `vfx-freeze-aoe` stays. SFX `sfx-weapon-freeze-aoe-explode` (index note only; no audio file).
